name: 要 + verb
explanation: 要 before a verb expresses wanting or intending to do something; its usual negative is 不想.

name: 最 degree adverb
explanation: 最 marks the highest degree or preference within a relevant set.

name: Approximate numbers 几 and 多
form: 几 + classifier; numeral + classifier + 多 (under 10); numeral + 多 + classifier (10 or more)
explanation: 几 indicates an indefinite small count before a classifier; 多 indicates an approximate amount, with position determined by the numeral range.

name: 是不是 questions
form: 是不是 + predicate; sentence + 是不是?
explanation: Use 是不是 to seek confirmation when the speaker has a tentative expectation; it can precede the predicate or appear at the beginning or end.

name: 每 + classifier
explanation: 每 before a classifier means each or every member of a set; 都 commonly follows when describing what applies to all.

name: 多 degree questions
explanation: 多 before an adjective asks about degree; the answer gives a measurement or quantity.

name: 的 phrases
explanation: 的 can nominalize a modifier phrase when the head noun is understood and omitted.

name: 一下 after a verb
explanation: 一下 presents an action as brief or light; its object may be omitted.

name: 真 exclamation
explanation: 真 before an adjective adds an emphatic, exclamatory sense such as really or indeed.

name: 是……的 emphasizing the agent
explanation: When an event is already established, 是……的 can identify or emphasize who performed it; negation places 不 before 是.

name: 的时候 time phrase
form: time expression / verb phrase + 的时候
explanation: 的时候 forms a time phrase meaning when or at the time that; it can follow a quantity of time or a verb phrase.

name: 已经
explanation: 已经 marks that an action has been completed or a state has already reached a degree.

name: 就 as a conclusion
explanation: 就 introduces a decision or conclusion based on what was just mentioned.

name: 还 meaning passable
explanation: 还 before an adjective can mean that something is acceptable or passable, often with a qualified evaluation.

name: 有点儿
explanation: 有点儿 marks a degree that the speaker often regards as undesirable or mildly unsatisfactory.

name: 怎么 asking why
explanation: 怎么 before a verb or adjective asks why something is so, commonly conveying surprise.

name: Reduplicated classifiers
explanation: Repeating a classifier means every item or member in the relevant set; 都 commonly follows.

name: 因为……所以……
explanation: Connects a cause clause to its result; either 因为 or 所以 may be omitted when the relation is clear.

name: 还 continuation
form: 还 + verb / adjective; 还没 + verb
explanation: 还 marks the continuation of an action or state; its negative form is 还没.

name: 就 early or quick occurrence
explanation: 就 emphasizes that the speaker regards an event as occurring early, quickly, or smoothly.

name: 离 distance
form: place / time / purpose + 离 + reference point
explanation: 离 expresses distance from a place, time, or purpose.

name: 呢
explanation: Sentence-final 呢 can indicate an ongoing situation or prompt a response about a topic already raised.

name: ……好吗?
explanation: A sentence-final 好吗? asks for the other person's opinion or agreement.

name: 再
explanation: 再 indicates repetition or continuation, or an action that will happen later under a stated circumstance.

name: Pivotal sentences
explanation: The object of the first verb is also the understood subject of the second; the first verb often expresses asking, letting, or telling.

name: Verb reduplication
form: V → VV / V一V; disyllabic verb → ABAB
explanation: Reduplication presents an action as brief, limited, slight, or attempted, often with a casual tone.

name: Result complements
explanation: A result complement after a verb states the result of the action. Negation uses 没(有) before the verb and omits sentence-final 了; questions may end in (了)没有.

name: 从 starting point
form: 从 + starting point (+ 到 + endpoint)
explanation: 从 introduces the starting point of a time span, route, process, or sequence and often pairs with 到.

name: 第 ordinal
explanation: 第 before a number phrase marks order or sequence.

name: 不要……了 / 别……了
form: 不要 / 别 + verb phrase + 了
explanation: This imperative discourages or forbids an action, often signaling that it should stop or not continue.

name: 对 relationship
explanation: 对 introduces the person or thing toward which an attitude, effect, or relation is directed.

name: Verb phrase as attributive
explanation: A verb or verb phrase used to modify a noun is linked to it with 的.

name: 比 comparison
form: A + 比 + B + adjective; A + 没有 + B + adjective
explanation: 比 forms a comparison; 没有 expresses that A does not reach B's degree. Difference phrases can specify the size of the gap.

name: 可能
form: 可能 + verb phrase; 可能 + subject + predicate
explanation: 可能 marks a possibility or estimate and can appear before the verb phrase or before the subject.

name: Degree complements
form: verb (+ repeated verb/object) + 得 + degree phrase
explanation: 得 introduces a phrase describing the degree of an action or state. With an object, place the object before the verb or repeat the verb; negation follows 得.

name: 比 with degree complements
form: A + 比 + B + verb + 得 + complement; A + verb + 得 + 比 + B + complement
explanation: With a degree complement, 比 may precede the verb or the complement phrase.

name: 着 state
explanation: 着 after a verb marks the continuation of a state. Negation places 没 before the verb; a yes-no question may end with 没有.

name: 不是……吗 rhetorical question
explanation: This form reminds the listener of something or expresses the speaker's confusion or dissatisfaction.

name: 往 direction
explanation: 往 introduces the direction in which movement proceeds.

name: 过 experience
explanation: 过 after a verb marks a past experience that is not presented as continuing to the present. Negation uses 没(有) before the verb; questions may end with 没有.

name: 虽然……但是……
form: 虽然 + clause, 但是 + contrasting clause
explanation: Links two clauses in an adversative or concessive relation.

name: Frequency complement 次
form: verb (+ 过) + number + 次 + object
explanation: 次 after the predicate counts how many times an action occurs; with a place as object, the frequency phrase can appear before or after that object.

name: 要……了 imminent action
form: 快要 / 快 / 就要 / 要 + verb phrase + 了
explanation: Marks an event that is about to happen. When an explicit time expression is present, use 就要……了.

name: 都……了
form: 都 + time / amount / situation + 了
explanation: 都……了 means already and commonly adds emphasis or impatience.
